# Test fixtures

These saved provider responses and Tranco list files support offline parser and
fallback tests. Some provider fixtures retain values, timestamps, host names, or
rank rows captured during bounded implementation checks so the tests can exercise
the actual response shapes. They are test inputs, not public examples, current
estimates, or endorsements of the captured values.

Keep README demos, screenshots, and other public examples synthetic and clearly
labelled. Do not copy fixture counts or dates into public-facing examples.
